system.description: Renegade god of limitless destruction and Chaos's self-destructive streak, loathed by the other gods, feeding on their power and eventually betraying even his own.
system.summary: Renegade god of limitless destruction and Chaos's self-destructive streak, loathed by the other gods, feeding on their power and eventually betraying even his own.
commandments: Draw strength from hatred and show enemies no mercy.
Everything is fated to end, so tear everything down.
Treachery pays; those who cannot protect themselves deserve their fate.
directives: Serve no master, not even Malal; destroy whatever enrages you.
Take what makes others admired and turn it ironically against them.
Save no one, yourself included; bring certain annihilation.
Unmake every bond and stay alone even among people.
Honor and slay Malal alike, glorify and burn Chaos, and fade into nothing.

cults.name: Street Gangs
cults.summary: Alienated youths who tear down establishments and themselves without deeper motives; the few survivors become terrorists and warlords.

cults.name: Singular Champions
cults.summary: Lone avengers consumed by destroying what they hate, whom Malal keeps isolated by ensuring those close to them die.
